overview.description: The Corgi ONTO 2x Daily ETF (ONTX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund provides 2x leveraged exposure, less fees and expenses, to the daily price movement for shares of Onto Innovation, Inc. (TICKER: ONTO), through derivatives such as swaps. ONTX was launched on Jun 24, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.
